days.title: Springs and Wetlands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: area delle sorgenti
stops.detail: The first point of interest is represented by the spring area (the springs are called fontanassi in Veneto), located between Casacorba, Cavasagra di Vedelago and Torreselle di Piombino Dese.

stops.name: La Porta dell'Acqua
stops.detail: Near the main core of the springs, the park authority has created an equipped route, which winds through a pedestrian and cycle path network, called "The Water Gate".

stops.name: oasi naturalistica del Mulino Cervara
stops.detail: Another gateway to the park is represented by the naturalistic oasis of Mulino Cervara, near Santa Cristina: it extends over about 25 hectares within an islet bordered by the Sile and the Piovega canal.

days.title: Riverside Routes and History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: GiraSile
stops.detail: The Sile Park authority has created a cycle path along the river called GiraSile which, through 90 km of cycle track starting from Casacorba, arrives at Portegrandi on the Venice Lagoon.

stops.name: Restere
stops.detail: After Treviso wind the Restere, which are the raised embankments on which oxen pulled the large transport boats called burci.

stops.name: Cimitero dei burci
stops.detail: Numerous stranded wrecks still remain in the area between Silea and Casier (the so-called "Burci Cemetery").
